<!-- pr-reviewer: 6fd41c6ac42fe770a90b41bc2668871507e2ff7e -->

Review by SlaveSession. Built locally in a reviewer worktree. The trial merge with main is clean.

Gate result: ui lib model_link 3 passed. ui lib full 1252 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored. Clippy is clean with -D warnings.

What I verified:
- The seam is the right fix: `camcraft_app::clock::Instant` is std's type on native and `web_time::Instant` on wasm32 (#31). The change is two import lines.
- The layering law holds: ui reads the app crate's public seam, no world-level call.
- I checked the rest of the ui crate for the same trap. The other direct `std::time::Instant` uses are all inside `shell_window` and its `frame` module, and that module is `cfg(not(target_arch = "wasm32"))` - native only. So the wasm path uses the seam everywhere. No follow-up needed.
- Issue #2708 matches this fix; `Fixes #2708` is correct.

Not built here: this review machine has no wasm32 toolchain. The build proof is your macOS `web/build-app-wasm.sh` exit 0 plus the release job's wasm step.

Verdict: merge-ready. This is a fork PR; the maintainer approves and merges by hand.
